papers.title: Domain Adaptation in Low-Resource Scientific NLP
papers.abstract: Cross-domain generalization degrades substantially when evaluating NLP architectures on out-of-distribution scientific texts without explicit target domain adaptation.

papers.title: Efficient Attention Mechanisms for Long-Context Scientific Retrieval
papers.abstract: We investigate quadratic computational complexity in full self-attention and propose block-sparse memory approximations for long-document scientific retrieval.

papers.title: Multimodal Evidence Extraction from Clinical Case Reports
papers.abstract: We introduce a multimodal evidence extraction framework for clinical case reports, highlighting annotated data scarcity and imaging alignment bottlenecks.

papers.title: Robustness and Evaluation Bias in Scientific Text Summarization
papers.abstract: N-gram overlap metrics fail to penalize factual hallucinations in abstractive summarization, motivating atomic sentence decomposition for claim checking.

papers.title: Contrastive Representation Learning for Scientific Citation Graphs
papers.abstract: Standard negative sampling assumes citation homophily, resulting in false negatives when embedding dense interdisciplinary subfields.

papers.title: Adversarial Robustness and Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Deep Learning
papers.abstract: Empirical analysis showing deep neural networks suffer severe accuracy drops under slight covariate shift in domain distributions.

papers.title: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling via State Space Formulations
papers.abstract: Structured state space models achieve sub-quadratic memory complexity on ultra-long sequences while retaining expressive associative recall.

papers.title: Cross-Modal Biomedical Entity Linking from Electronic Health Records
papers.abstract: Entity linking algorithms exhibit poor robustness when handling noisy social clinical narratives and sparse ontology mappings.

papers.title: Mitigating Hallucination via Fact-Checking Decomposition in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Despite scale, generative language models hallucinate unsupported claims; we present an automated factuality audit framework.

papers.title: Topological Homophily and Citation Recommendation in Interdisciplinary Research
papers.abstract: Interdisciplinary discovery bridges disjoint citation communities, exposing vulnerabilities in local neighborhood graph embeddings.
